name: docs-site
category: Documentation · Markdown + config → responsive multi-page static docs site
description: Generate a responsive, multi-page, self-contained static documentation site from Markdown content and a small JSON config. Builds the doc structure automatically, wires a configurable navigation menu, integrates existing Markdown and data formats, and adds a data list page type with client-side sorting (commit count, last-updated), text filters and status badges. Layout follows the ragx site design (860px mobile breakpoint, full-screen nav panel, fluid content, lightbox, theme and EN/中 toggle).
